end.summary:
Practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
Used a rocket example to discuss cylinder parts: curved side and two flat ends.
Identified a candle as a cone and explained its pointy top and flat bottom.
Identified a ball as a sphere because it has no corners.
Cone orientation mix-up was corrected at turn 11; teach-back was not yet passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised shape names through a rocket, candle and ball, asking about each shape’s features. Aditya used the curved side and flat ends to discuss a cylinder, and explained why a ball is a sphere. They mixed up whether turning a cone changes its shape, and this was corrected later by noting that its shape stays the same. At home, try finding one object for each shape and naming one feature, such as a point, curve or flat face.
